source.author: verg
source.text: Quin et supremo cum lumine vita reliquit, non tamen omne malum miseris nec funditus omnes corporeae excedunt pestes, penitusque necesse est multa diu concreta modis inolescere miris.
source.text_original: Quin et supremo cum lumine vita reliquit, / non tamen omne malum miseris nec funditus omnes / corporeae excedunt pestes, penitusque necesse est / multa diu concreta modis inolescere miris.
source.text_english: Indeed, even when life has departed with the last light, yet not all evil, nor all the plagues of the body, leave wretched men utterly; and it is necessary that many things, deeply congealed within, should grow and harden over a long time in wondrous ways.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: quam sententiam poeta sic explicauit: quin et supremo cum lumine uita reliquit, non tamen omne malum miseris nec funditus omnes corporeae excedunt pestes, penitusque necesse est multa diu modis inolescere miris .
reuse.text_original: quam sententiam poeta sic explicauit: quin et supremo cum lumine uita reliquit, non tamen omne malum miseris nec funditus omnes corporeae excedunt pestes, penitusque necesse est multa diu modis inolescere miris .
reuse.text_english: The poet explained this thought as follows: indeed, even when life has departed at the last light, not yet do all evils leave the wretched, nor do all bodily plagues depart utterly from them; and it is necessary that many things should grow deep within for a long time in wondrous ways.
